analysis: age-conditioned MAR versus matched-eligible-feature MCAR sensitivity
masking: test-only; age is observed in both conditions; all other feature cells eligible
mar_mechanism: cellwise Bernoulli with logit propensity intercept calibrated to nominal expected rate; log-odds increase ln(2) per SD of observed age
preprocessing: train-only label encoding/scaling; median imputer fitted on training matrix only
classifier: trained on clean training split once per dataset/seed/model and kept frozen during both stress conditions
inference: paired exact two-sided Wilcoxon over ten seed-specific FMG contrasts; Holm adjustment within rate across 12 dataset-model comparisons
limitations: one observed covariate (age) and one specified propensity form
not evidence for all MAR or MNAR mechanisms
benchmark seeds are repeated splits, not independent populations
